p: go down to Egypt for help: There were two special reasons why the Israelites should not join with the Egyptians: first, because the Lord had commanded them never to return there, De 17:16,28:68 lest they should forget the benefit of their redemption: and secondly, lest they should be corrupted with the superstition and idolatry of the Egyptians, and so forsake God, Jer 2:18.
seek the LORD: Meaning, that they forsake the Lord, if they put their trust in worldly things: for they cannot trust in both.
wise: And knows their crafty enterprises, and will bring all to nought.
helpeth shall fall: Meaning, both the Egyptians and the Israelites.

down to fight for mount Zion: He shows the Jews that if they would put their trust in him, he is so able, that no one can resist his power and so care over them, as a bird over her young, which ever flies about them for their defence: which similitude the scripture uses in various places, as in De 32:11, Mt 23:37.
deeply revolted: He touches their conscience that they might earnestly feel their grievous sins, and so truly repent, for as much as now they are almost drowned and past recovery.
cast away his idols of silver: By these fruits your repentance will be known, as in Isa 2:20.
Then shall the Assyrian fall with: When your repentance appears.
strong hold for fear: This was accomplished soon after when Sennacherib's army was discomfited, and he fled to his castle in Nineveh for comfort.
fire is in Zion: To destroy his enemies.
